# Remote Control Agent v0.1.44

## Changes
- Fix credential-free Windows Session identity recovery.
- Remove PowerShell FileSystem provider dependency from private ACL resource checks.
- Preserve strict ACL ownership, inheritance and reparse-point security checks.
- Add native Windows detached-child regression tests and bounded diagnostics.
- Preserve existing permanent-device behavior and optional Session bootstrap.
